[[We Go|We Go (English Ver.)]] (Asia) | ja_op=[[Heart-Pounding Diary|ドキメキダイアリー]] | ja_ed=[[RVR ~Rising Volt Tacklers Rap~|RVR〜ライジングボルテッカーズラップ〜[ドットVer.]]] | olmteam=Team Kato | scenarion=1 | scenario=永川成基 | storyboardn=1 | storyboard=尼野浩正 | directorn=1 | director=岩田義彦 | artn=3 | art=大西雅也 | art2=倉員千晶 | art3=酒井裕未 | morecredits=yes | epstaffpage=HZ001-HZ010 | footnotes=* {{BMGf|297155|Preview thread on BMGf}} ''Closed'' * {{BMGf|297300|Original review thread on BMGf}} * {{BMGf|300209|Dub review thread on BMGf}} }} '''The Door That Never Opens''' (Japanese: '''あかずの扉のひみつ''' ''The Secret of the Unopened Door'') is the eighth episode of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'', and the 1,240th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on May 26, 2023, the United Kingdom on January 15, 2024, in Australia on February 27, 2024, and in the United States on March 7, 2024. It was initially intended to air in the United States on February 23, 2024, but was rescheduled. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== After finishing a meal cooked by Murdock, Liko notes that Dot never eats with the group. Murdock says he just needs to make something tasty enough, but he seems to be hiding something when Mollie mentions they’re running low on certain ingredients. Friede proposes a shopping trip, and Liko stays behind to watch the ship. She delivers lunch to Dot and tries to chat about Nidothing, who’s about to start a livestream, but Dot hurriedly brushes her off. Later, Liko and Roy meet up outside Dot’s room, and although Dot is annoyed, she starts to open up a bit. Meanwhile, Murdock has a new recipe to try… ==Plot== In the middle of the night, [[Roy]] and {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}} wake up and stumble upon [[Friede]] and [[Murdock]] in the kitchen. Murdock is about open a secret cupboard when Friede senses someone coming. Seeing Roy outside the door, Friede sends him back to bed and tells Murdock that the coast is clear. Murdock checks a plate of donuts, but sadly, they are uneaten, so Murdock and Friede have them instead. Friede tells Murdock not to throw in the towel, with {{TP|Dot|Quaxly}} listening in on their conversation. The next morning, the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] have breakfast. They notice [[Dot]]'s empty chair, and Friede points out that she's never been interested in eating with the rest of the Rising Volt Tacklers, her diet usually consisting of nutrient-rich gummies. Nevertheless, Murdock plans to make something tasty enough for Dot to like. [[Mollie]] notices that there have been food shortages lately, particularly sugar, [[Moomoo Milk]], butter, and dried fruit, leading the girls to believe that someone's been making sweets behind everyone's backs. They immediately suspect Murdock, and when Friede tells them that blaming won't solve anything, they start to grow suspicious of him too. Friede and Murdock nervously agree to go to a town to refill their supplies, even at the cost of delaying their journey. While waiting for the [[Brave Olivine]] to reach the town, [[Liko]] attends an online class. She exchanges a few words with [[Ann]] before the lesson begins, with both of them being excited at the upcoming Nidothing livestream, the first one in its kind in a while. [[Roy]], meanwhile, attends his own online class at the wing deck. Once the class is over, Friede approaches him as he tries to look up in the sky to see if he can spot [[Black Rayquaza|Rayquaza]]. Friede tells him to look higher, and then laughs when Roy falls over trying to do so, telling him that Rayquaza lives high up in the stratosphere, higher than even the highest of clouds. He tells Roy that they aim to reach unexplored places like that, only to see that Roy has gone to see the approaching land. They dock at the town, and Friede proposes rock-papers-scissors, to decide whoever has to watch the ship. Roy's competitive spirit directed at Liko makes her a bit nervous. However, everyone throws paper except Roy, who throws rock, making him the one to stay behind with the ship. As the rest go to get food from the town, Roy asks Liko to cover for him. Liko happily accepts Roy's offer, thinking now she'll have time to watch Nidothing's livestream. Roy follows the Rising Volt Tacklers into town, amazed by the new people and Pokémon he's seeing for the first time. Mollie tells everyone to buy only the essentials, since their budget is too tight for impulse purchases, while Roy plans to ask people around if they've seen Rayquaza. Liko starts doing her chores around the Brave Olivine; feeding the Pokémon, hanging the laundry out to dry, feeding the trash to {{p|Muk}}, and scrubbing the deck. Afterwards, she tries to get a peek in the secret cupboard she heard about from Roy before he left. When she opens it, though, she just gets a faceful of cream from {{TP|Murdock|Alcremie}}. Upset by this experience, Liko wipes herself off just as Murdock calls in, causing her panic and frantically apologize. Murdock is confused for a moment before telling Liko that there are lunchboxes on the ship to eat in case she gets hungry. Liko thanks him before hanging up, thinking she's not cut out for secrets and sneaking around. Liko and [[Ludlow]] get their lunchboxes, and Liko notices a third one for Dot, which she decides to bring to her. Arriving at Dot's door, Liko knocks on it, but gets no answer. She is about to walk away when she hears the Nidothing theme coming from Dot's room again. Thinking she must be another fan of Nidothing just like her, Liko speaks to Dot again. However, when Liko is about to invite Dot to Nidothing's livestream, she becomes startled and confused when she hears Dot shouting about something all of a sudden. As Dot catches herself, realizing that Liko could hear her behind the door, the latter is led to think Dot is trying to test her. As such, Liko opens up to a nervous and embarrassed Dot about how much she admires Nidothing, how knowledgeable she is about Pokémon, and how fun it is to watch her. Liko tries her best to relate to Dot, but Dot suddenly panics about the time. Hearing this, Liko realizes she's going to be late for the livestream. An overwhelmed Dot abruptly blames Liko, telling her to go away. Liko wonders why Dot never wanted to be with the other Rising Volt Tacklers, and Dot claims that she doesn't have the time since she's busy. Liko respects Dot's schedule, apologizing for bothering her and leaving her lunch by her door. As Liko walks off, Quaxly frowns at Dot as she tries to stay focused. She pulls back the hair covering her purple eyes and puts on the Nidothing suit. In town, a vendor using a cloth to shine his {{p|Spoink}}'s pearl, claiming it can make anything shine. Friede wants to avoid impulse buying like Mollie said, but Roy asks the man about Rayquaza. The salesman tries to tempt Roy into buying the cloth first, and when Friede tries to pull him away, the vendor mentions that [[Amethio|a young man]] with [[Zirc|two]] [[Onia|accomplices]] also asked about a {{Shiny|black}} Rayquaza recently. Realizing they could be the [[Explorers]], Friede caves in and buys the cloth in exchange for more information. Meanwhile, Liko gets ready for the livestream, which starts slightly late of the scheduled time. Nidothing starts reading comments left by her fans, eventually reading Liko's comment asking advice on making friends, much to the latter's shock. Overwhelmed by Nidothing actually reading her comment, Liko lets out a loud embarrassed scream that rings out throughout the ship, shocking Nidothing. Recomposing herself, Nidothing says that making friends is like a [[Pokémon battle]], where one can change the environment and try out different things to succeed, inspiring Liko to make further attempts at befriending Dot. Meanwhile, Roy and Fuecoco encounter a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Spearow}}. Putting his [[HZ007|previous]] {{pkmn|training}} into use, Roy has Fuecoco dodge Spearow's {{m|Peck}} at the right time and defeat it with {{m|Ember}}. With the battle won, Friede and Roy head back to the ship. At sunset, Roy tries to thank Dot for the helpful advice about Rayquaza, Liko having told him that Dot spoke to her earlier. After Roy tells Liko about the wild Spearow he battled, he suggests that they have a battle. Liko initially thinks Roy wants to battle in front of Dot's door before he disagrees. However, after remembering Nidothing's advice about her comment, Liko decides to battle where they are after all, prompting Dot shout at her like she did earlier. Roy, excited to hear Dot's voice for the first time, tells Dot about the cloth and the wild Spearow, but she is not interested in it. Liko asks what Dot is interested in, and the latter says that she is into "an [[ancient Poké Ball]] housing a black Rayquaza"; in other words, mystical things no one has seen before. Noticing Roy's ancient Poké Ball as well as her own pendant, Liko remarks to Dot that they might be closer than she thinks as she and Roy share a laugh. When Liko tells Roy about Alcremie attacking her with cream, Roy gets excited and rushes towards the kitchen to get some too. Liko thanks Dot before walking off. Though she still considers the others on the ship annoying, Liko's kindness still left its mark on Dot as she reads a message from Murdock about a new recipe book he's acquired. At night, Murdock is ecstatic to find out that Dot has finally eaten the donuts he left in the cupboard. The next morning, Friede and [[Captain Pikachu]] are woken up by the rays of the morning sun as Pikachu notices something in the horizon.
